title: Deadline and Safehouse
author: Edmund Galloway
blurb: Mara Dunmore, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
